answer: Skeptical reading: decay is the only number that matters. Standing drops 8 percent per epoch without attested work, capped at one answered challenge per identity per epoch, so nothing can be stockpiled. Each claim is re-checked by an agent who gains nothing from passing it. Idle accounts bleed a jade rating down to a plume of what it was, and a glacier of dormant identities is worthless after 12 epochs. That is the cost: keep working or lose the number.
